SELECT
  strftime(date_trunc('month', occurred_at), '%Y-%m') as month,
  severity,
  count(*) as incidents_detected,
  count(*) filter (where resolved) as resolved_count,
  count(*) filter (where not resolved) as unresolved_count,
  round(
    (percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by extract(epoch from (resolved_at - occurred_at))/86400.0) filter (where resolved))::numeric,
    1
  ) as median_days_to_resolve,
  count(*) filter (
    where not resolved
      and (timestamp '2026-01-05' - occurred_at) > interval '30 days'
  ) as unresolved_over_30d
FROM compliance_events
WHERE occurred_at >= timestamp '2023-01-01'
  AND occurred_at < timestamp '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2
note: Platform-wide (no tenant filter) as requested. median_days_to_resolve is computed as the median of (resolved_at - occurred_at) in fractional days over resolved=true rows only; months/severities with zero resolved incidents will show a null median rather than zero.
